The care crew raised a concern about traveler questions, and we are grateful for your note. We understand that your experience with the Companion Animal Travel Desk did not reflect the standard of attentive support that Aurelia Skyways intends to provide. Your complaint indicates that communication felt unclear and that the handling of your companion animal arrangements did not leave you confident in the care being taken.

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress this caused. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for coordinating care from booking through pickup, and that responsibility includes clear guidance, careful recordkeeping, and prompt follow-through when service needs change. We regret that this process did not feel dependable in your case. A safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention for each relevant case, and staff record service changes in the desk ledger so the full team can maintain continuity. We are reviewing your report in that light so we can identify where our practice fell short and reinforce the expected standards.

Your note has been shared with the appropriate care team for review. We are looking closely at the handling of the service details, the timing of responses, and the tone of the communication you received. When a traveler places trust in Aurelia Skyways to safeguard a companion animal, that trust must be met with steady, respectful service. If a correction or follow-up is needed in your file, the desk will ensure it is completed with care and documented properly.

We appreciate the opportunity to address this matter and to improve the experience for future travelers and their animals. The Companion Animal Travel Desk remains committed to careful coordination, humane handling, and clear communication at every stage of the journey. Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for helping us strengthen our service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
